==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I dive kicked Ruby Wielder in the back. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Ruby Wielder is a flying, sparkling ruby, faceless humanoid wielding a glowing, magical, ruby trident.)

A piece of his parasitic ruby glow tried to bond with me.

My symbiote removed the parasite from me. (My slime alien symbiote suit resembles a smooth full body slimy green bodysuit.) (I think the ruby red energy on the Ruby Wielder might also be a symbiote, which might mean that the hero of legend may still exist underneath the symbiote.)
